Heard on the question of admission and interim relief.

2 . In this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India the petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs :-
a) Direct the respondents to consider the further acquisition of the land admeasuring 1065.63 sq. ft. and also area which will be acquired for digging pole as part of the acquired land and the compensation to be decided on it.
b) Direct respondent no.02 to take into consideration all the documents and evidences produced by the petitioner in support of his application in case no.
346/Arbitration/2022 pending before him before deciding the claim of the petitioner.
c)That, it may kindly be directed to expedite the proceedings pending before the respondent no.2 i.e. Court of Additional Collector(Land Acquisition), Indore in case no. 346/Arbitration/2022.
d) Direct the respondents to consider the land as an industrial land to determine and calculate the amount of compensation.

e) That, it may kindly be directed to respondent no.2 and respondent no.1 to determine and compute the amount of compensation rationally after taking into consideration the market value of the land and properly applying the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: f) That, any other relief whom this Hon'ble Court deems fit be granted.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner's land bearing survey no. 930/3 situated at Village - Kelod Kartal, Tehsil and Distt. Indore was acquired by the Sub Divisional Magistrate (Revenue) Khudel, Distt. Indore and competent authority Land Acquisition for the purpose of construction of National Highway 347-BG via award dated 30.12.2021 passed in case no.
7/A-82/2020-21 and granted compensation to the petitioner.

sentences.text: The petitioner has filed an objection before the competent authority, land acquisition,Indore in the year 2019 on the ground that the compensation for the acquired land has not been determined properly without taking into consideration the fact that the acquired land had already been diverted for industrial purpose and therefore, the compensation should be on higher side.

Petitioner also filed a under protest letter on 26.05.2022 before the competent authority, land acquisition stating the details of claims with respect to compensation of acquired land, but he had not been given the opportunity of being heard and the compensation was determined without following the process as mentioned in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The petitioner has filed an application u/S 3(g)(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956(referred to as 'the Act of 1956' hereinafter) on 16.09.2022 before the Court of Upper Collector,
Indore against the order dated 30.12.2021 passed by the competent authority i.e. Land Acquisition Officer, Khudel Distt. Indore which has not been decided yet.
Moreso, after passing of the award dated 30.12.2021, 1065.63 sq.ft. land was further acquired from survey no. 929/3, 930/3, Village Kehlod, Kartal belonging to the petitioner.

In respect of the said acquired land, panchnama was prepared on 18.05.2023 by the concerned officials of National Highway Authority of India(referred to as 'NHAI' hereinafter), but no compensation has been determined and given to the petitioner and NHAI has further proposed to acquire more land belonging to the petitioner.
Hence, the Additional Collector(Land Acquisition), Indore be directed to decide the application filed by the petitioner considering the documents and evidences produced before him.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and perused the record.
5.

On perusal of the impugned order, it is seen that respondent authorities have determined the compensation awarded the petitioner in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: So far as the petitioner's application u/S 3(g)(5) of the Act of 1956 which is pending consideration is concerned, the competent authority shall advert to the same.

6. In view of the aforesaid, this Court is of the considered view that instead of keeping this petition pending it would be appropriate to dispose it of with direction to the competent authority/respondent no.2, the Additional Collector (Land Acquisition), Indore to decide the pending application dated 16.09.2022 filed by the petitioner u/S 3(g)(5) of the Act of 1956 by considering all the documents and evidence placed with the aforesaid application, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order passed today.
7. The writ petition stands disposed off.
I t is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.

(S. A. DHARMADHIKARI)

Indore. .
The petitioner has filed an objection before the competent authority, land acquisition,Indore in the year 2019 on the ground that the compensation for the acquired land has not been determined properly without taking into consideration the fact that the acquired land had already been diverted for industrial purpose and therefore, the compensation should be on higher side.
Petitioner also filed a under protest letter on 26.05.2022 before the competent authority, land acquisition stating the details of claims with respect to compensation of acquired land, but he had not been given the opportunity of being heard and the compensation was determined without following the process as mentioned in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.
The petitioner has filed an application u/S 3(g)(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956(referred to as 'the Act of 1956' hereinafter) on 16.09.2022 before the Court of Upper Collector,
Indore against the order dated 30.12.2021 passed by the competent authority i.e. Land Acquisition Officer, Khudel Distt. Indore which has not been decided yet.
On perusal of the impugned order, it is seen that respondent authorities have determined the compensation awarded the petitioner in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
So far as the petitioner's application u/S 3(g)(5) of the Act of 1956 which is pending consideration is concerned, the competent authority shall advert to the same.
